title: EffectUtility
desc: Attribute-driven emit helper + Beam transparency tween (keypoint by keypoint).

title: VFX library
desc: Compact VFX library: copy-to-position, follow, rescale, emit by attributes, tag-driven emit loops.

title: Particle helpers
desc: Highest-lifetime lookup, emit all, toggle, scale lifetime, tween model scale.

title: Fx controller (burst / attach / aura / mesh / projectile / light)
desc: Most complete VFX controller: burst, attach-to-part, full-body aura, growing mesh shockwave, projectile, light flash.

title: Limb trails
desc: Attach a trail or particle part to a limb for N seconds, then let it fade in place.

title: Ability: charge, projectile, explosion
desc: Reference ability timeline: charge-up tweens -> projectile -> multi-emitter explosion -> knockback.

title: Barrage arms + shockwaves
desc: Bezier-curve ghost arms + tiny shockwave rings for a barrage / rapid punch.

title: Black hole portal
desc: Procedural layered portal (open / close / flare / suck) animated every frame.

title: Boss aura with distance culling
desc: Client aura manager: idle/run emitter rates, pulsing glow, flickering arcs, distance culling at 8 Hz.

title: Headshot screen effect
desc: Hit-confirm screen punch: blur + color correction + small FOV dip.

title: Flashbang screen
desc: Flashbang: white frame in 0.15 s, hold, fade out 3 s, ear ringing.

title: Bullet impact & blood FX
desc: Per-material bullet impacts oriented to the surface normal, tinted to the hit part, plus blood.

title: Firework burst
desc: Ring of firework bursts with staged emits and safe sound cleanup.

title: Confetti FX
desc: Self-contained UI confetti + world burst for rewards / celebrations.

title: Death effect module
desc: Cosmetic death effect as a function(char) module (how MM2 stores death effects).

title: Lightning fade
desc: Tiny classic: fade a bolt model out frame by frame.

title: EffectPlayer (pattern)
desc: Clone any effect template to a position or onto a part, emit by attributes, auto cleanup, Stop() for loops.

title: ScreenEffects (pattern)
desc: Flash, color tint pulse, blur pulse and desaturate, safe to call repeatedly.

title: Lightning (pattern)
desc: Procedural jagged lightning bolts with branches, light flash and flicker; crackling arcs between parts.

title: Shockwave (pattern)
desc: Expanding ground ring, expanding sphere, and a crater of rocks that copy the ground's material.
